NewBuilds.title: New builds and investment property in Albania
NewBuilds.description: Off-plan and under-construction homes on the Albanian coast, with the handover date and the ownership paperwork stated on every listing.
NewBuilds.heading: New builds and investment property in Albania
NewBuilds.intro: Property bought before it is finished is cheaper, and it carries risks a finished flat does not: the handover can slip, and the ownership certificate may still be in process. Every listing here states which stage the building is at and when the keys are promised, so the two are yours to weigh rather than ours to gloss over.
NewBuilds.empty: No unfinished buildings are listed at the moment. Everything currently on the site is finished and handed over — browse the whole catalogue instead.
